title: First localization package
statement: Let B, C and the target localization be the rings defined in the parent node. The first conjunct asserts the existence of an A-algebra map phi : B → C[t_{ij}, z]_z sending x_k to the class of x_k in C, every y_i to 0, z to z, and t_{ij} to t_{ij}; it also asserts an A-algebra equivalence e : B_z ≃ C[t_{ij}, z]_z satisfying e(algebraMap(B,B_z,b)) = phi b for every b. This is exactly the first localization assertion of Stacks Project Tag 07FA, with the Stacks misprint corrected from C[y_i,z,z⁻¹] to C[t_{ij},z,z⁻¹].
